content: Meera Chauhan called to inquire about her expired travel policy (TRV-2024-0789) for an upcoming trip on 10 October 2026. Agent Ravi Menon informed her that expired policies cannot provide retroactive coverage and assisted her with issuing a new 30-day policy for $145. Ravi explained the activation process, which involves completing an online form, uploading passport and itinerary documents via a secure link he will email, and making a payment by credit card or PayPal, after which the policy will be instantly active and a PDF document sent.

action_items: Ravi to send a secure renewal/payment link via email
Meera to fill out the online form and upload passport and itinerary
Meera to complete payment via credit card, PayPal, or bank transfer
